reviews.text:
Beehive vets is amazing. The staff are lovely and friendly.
Thank you for looking after my little Maple. 🧡 …

We cannot commend the staff at Beehive vets highly enough, throughout the care they gave our 11 year old chihuahua ‘Teddy’ during his operation for the removal of his very bad teeth. All have been helpful from the moment we first took him in, then throughout the procedure to its completion. The vet allayed our concerns and worries explaining everything step by step. The after care was just as good  having received a call to see how he was doing and organising follow up appointments.
Snowie happy with good health thank you olivia
The team at Beehive are amazing, from the lovely receptionists to the nurses. They took great care of Sully when he was booked for castration. Would definitely recommend!

Amazing vets, so kind with the animals and gentle. Shadow was very scared about her first visit but behaved so well and got lots of attention. Good advice and open conversations. Wouldn’t take her anywhere else

I took both my cats to vets.
I was greeted with a smile and helpful staff.
My pets were handled with respect an kindness.
In all a good experience thank you. Would recommend you to others x
Excellent service and approachable people, would definitely recommend.

Great care by the nurse Chloe today.  She did an annual check on my rabbit and he’s not the easiest to handle but she managed beautifully and fully checked his teeth hocks, clipped nails and vaccinated.  They were happy to come to the car to call me in  so I could sit quietly there with my rabbit until his appointment

I was recommended Beehive vets when my dog Bella needed surgery to repair her knee ligaments, and they were amazing. Such a welcoming, caring , professional practice, I highly recommend them to everyone. Bella has other ongoing health issues, and we receive the same superb care and treatment each visit . Thankyou for everything. Annis and Bella Price.
As always very friendly and experienced service. Called in early as I like to be early as my animals are my babies. Lovely with the cat

We recently registered my bulldog here as he became quite unwell really quickly. We tried reaching out to multiple vets before getting in touch with beehive and they all said they couldn’t help. Beehive has been great since day 1! My bulldog is very wary of strangers and can be difficult to handle! This did not stop beehive helping and they do everything to make the vet’s visit as easy as possible.I couldn’t recommend them more!
Great place and caring vet care. The staff are always friendly and helpful, I like the little touches of a separate waiting area for cats with blankets and calming sprays.
Perfect experience. They were lovely and very kind to an older Doberman .....Lily. Thank you
Outstanding service making Tina and us at ease thank you so much as you can she was so tired but eating and fine 2 hrs later
Brilliant vets. Very easy to get appointment and all staff are so friendly and caring. Everything you could want from a vet.
What a wonderful place. My dog was most welcome
Lovely, welcoming staff. Always leave feeling like my animals are very looked after and cared for

They are always so good with Bear. I wouldn’t go anywhere else with him.
The best vets we have used.

Lovely friendly team that put myself and my 2 nervous dogs at ease.
Although it’s a bit further away than my local vets it is certainly worth the travel.
Thank you Beehive vets 🥰

Lovely consultation with Olivia Midnight really likes her and was happily eating dreamies I struggle a lot with vets visits due to recent bereavements but the atmosphere is so nice here it makes going so much easier

Thank you Nigel for taking the time to leave us 5 stars, we really appreciate it. 🐝
 …

What a wonderful, welcoming place Beehive Vets is. We had problems with our pet but on calling into Beehive we got an immediate appointment and the lovely people there put our minds at rest and for this we’re truly grateful. Thank you Beehive and your superb staff

I took an injured pigeon ro Beehive vets in Rothwell who without hesitation said they would take a look . Unfortunately the pigeon had sustained a severe head injury so the kindest option was to euthanase.

They were so kind, showed compassion and sympathetic towards me as I got a little upset.

Id like to add i had contacted several other vets from the area who did not want to help

Beehive vets have my upmost respect.

I have taken my 2 dogs to beehive vets for years for their annual boosters and check ups.
Recently one had a routine spay and the team at beehive were great.
I took her for an extra appointment in between check ups as I had concerns and Olivia was fantastic.
You can tell she is passionate and genuinely cares about your pets. She was thoroughly checked over and given medication and the whole process moving forward was explained in detail and we left feeling much better and the rest of her recovery went great.

Been using Beehive Vets since they opened and would recommend them without hesitation. Excellent visit today with my whippet. Luke diagnosed him and explained .  everything. Very relaxed with us and the dog. It’s a very calm environment for dog and owner.
The receptionist lady were lovely and Olivia the vet was so kind and caring towards Rosie and I feel I have made the right choice by choice changeing to bee hive  thank you bee hive
Lovely vets and receptionists. Easy to book appointments.
Great location, with parking outside and staff are great

“Contacted them yesterday as my dog was unwell. I was able to get an appointment within 30 minutes, followed by a phone call about an hour later with the test results. I honestly can’t recommend them enough—such a caring and efficient service!”

We’re incredibly grateful for the clear explanations and sensible, compassionate approach. The vets here always focus on the right treatment while keeping stress to our pets to a minimum. Unlike other local vets we appreciate that they seem to put the animal’s wellbeing first rather than focusing on profit.
Honestly the best vets ive been to, they ease my anxiety with my animals, they are so supportive and caring. 100% worth the 5 stars
I took my Francis flumper rumper pie puss to get a bit of an MOT. The vet was lovely with him, she listened to my concerns and was was very helpful.
Took our car Teddy here there other day for some teeth removing. They seem to have done a great job. Staff are all really friendly.
I researched vets in my area and found Beehive with great reviews. I took my 2 cats here for treatment and couldn’t be happier at the service and care. 🐱

Changed our dogs vets to Beehive from a recommendation as we didn’t have a good experience with our old vets and the dog was so unhappy going. We’ve been today and he didn’t want to leave! The staff were amazing and the receptionist went above and beyond to help me with my two older kids and 3 month old baby. Made what could of been a stressful visit very easy and enjoyable
All very friendly staff n professional. Great advice. Would recommend.👍n loved Luna.

Lloyd was perfectly on time and carefully listened to my concerns about my dog. He carefully examined my pet  and diagnosed the issue immediately and prescribed the appropriate medication. The ladies on reception were lovely too. Brilliant vets that provide a great service.
Thank you so much.

Just taken my little 9 week old pup for his first vaccinations, from reception to the vet everyone was extremely friendly and professional.
They explained everything about the jabs and we even got 4 weeks free insurance
Jackson got a good lookover before his jab and he never felt a thing.
All in all a 5 star experience at a reasonable price.
Wonderful friendly vets nurses an reception
My first visit I’m very impressed

Within one week of being at Beehive the care and attention to detail from the team have been excellent. Quick results, great communication and genuine care in their approach to animals and their welfare. Really happy with the care & service for our dog Brucie - would highly recommend!
Thank you so much to all at Beehive Vets for attending to gizmo very quickly when he had a really sore paw .really grateful .

Always friendly service, no long wait.
Reasonably priced

What a lovely bunch, friendly, tentative, super efficient, i got in on the same day.  I was recommended by a friend , i also moved from a larger practice.   The reception staff friendly,
The veterinary was friendly, explained everything, did the procedure there and then setting expectations.  Made me and my fur boy feel very comfortable and stress free.

Im soo glad i moved.

Thank you
Thank you Jason for your feedback - we really appreciate it 🐝 …
Thank you Victoria for your 5 star review - we really value your feedback 🐝 …
Great people great service and very competitive price I couldn’t recommend them enough
Professional, friendly and puts you at ease. Thank you.

It's was Poppy's annual Kennel cough and  bravecto flea treatment today. Due to her being headshy and a bit anxious, we discussed with Esther prior and was able to give her some sedative to help.
On arrival, reception were welcoming, we were seen promptly, Luke was really friendly and professional and reduced alot of my fears also. He administered both treatments and we were on our way.
A 5* experience for us both. Thank you.

Very professional and very helpful.
Brilliant

Really good vets and great service,  my only point is that I dont like the new layout of the reception area as it seems more catered to dogs than cats and other pets
The old area seemed more tucked away for cats so they were less seen.
The new layout means I had to walk through where all the dogs were waiting with my cat in his carrier and waiting at the reception desk is right where all the dogs sit .Great vets though
Everyone here is so kind and professional, I know my lovely cat is in good hands here!

Lovely vets
Very nice staff.
Very clean and tidy

Fantastic, caring vets. Knowledgeable, transparent and a team I trust implicitly with my pup !

Dotty has been in the wars recently but the team are so kind, caring and knowledgeable that we felt reassured. Anyone who has a dog understands how precious they are and to have a team we can trust is incredibly reassuring.

Dotty loves the fuss she gets despite not loving the experience inc. sometimes having to be wrapped like a burrito !
Very pleased with the nurse did my dogs anal glands and even on the hottest day of the year did eyras like cutting his nails and advising on his teeth. Well done 👍 …

Best vets Bambi and I have had the pleasure of since moving to the area even though Bambi put them through their paces, they feel like family and we feel really at home and we are really in love with them, lots of extra love to all the staff there who are always so friendly too 🥰 …
Staff and vets were very helpful and advised what is best for Ollie

Been using beehive for the last few years. All the staff have been fantastic, good knowledge, don't rush you though appointments, take time to explain things for you to understand and really care for the animals 😊 …
Nice to find an independent vets rather than the normal big conglomerates you usually find. More personal service & also continuity.
Claire on reception is always welcoming and Olivia the vet was amazing with my old dog. She didn’t suggest excessive treatment, did what was best for my old dog and was so lovely with her.

We came here today for the first time and can not thank the staff enough. The reception staff were so friendly and kind, and made us feel at ease. The vet we saw was Chloe and again we can’t fault the service at all. She explained everything she was doing and why, and was amazing with our dog. Thank you😊 …

Simply the best, most attentive vets you could hope for. From the moment you walk in, the receptionists are warm, welcoming and genuinely understanding.
The vet was absolutely amazing and had so much time to explain everything in detail. I never once felt rushed, and every question I had was answered thoroughly and with real compassion.
My dog Jose can be quite nervous at the vets, but he was completely relaxed throughout — which says everything about the environment they create.
We came in with a worrying heart murmur diagnosis and left with a full specialist echo, a clear diagnosis, a management plan, and genuine peace of mind. The care and expertise here is exceptional.
I cannot recommend Beehive Vets highly enough. If you want a vets where your pet is treated as an individual and you're treated as a person — this is the place.

It would be lovely to find a vets that I can take my French bulldog to without the first comment being ‘oh she needs BOAS’
To put in to context , this was a vaccine booster appointment. She is 8 1/2 years in age and walks for at least an hour per day with absolutely no issues!! She doesn’t struggle to breathe and never has!
Yet again a vet that sees a frenchie and thinks ‘Kerching’
Please educate yourselves ! Not all these dogs need surgery !
Will be finding another vet .

Friendly, efficient service. The staff are very welcoming and my dogs seem to enjoy going there. Very unlike my previous vets which I had attended for over thirty years until they became part of the Linnaeus group. Would recommend this practice to anyone.

Absolutely amazing vet's. So kind and caring. Nothing is too much trouble, when it comes to our beloved pets. Not expensive or over the top prices, will definitely recommend Beehive vet's to everyone.

As always, excellent service and standards of professionalism at Beehive Vets in Rothwell. Staff are friendly, knowledgeable and very approachable. My cocker spaniel gets excited at every visit - as she always receives lots of attention and fuss! Can’t say better than that! First rate local vets - highly recommended.
Wud never use them again.even if only vets in country

Took Greta for her vaccine (usually it's for her anul glands) she was more relaxed, the vet was really lovely (can't remember her name) Greta was happy she got lots of treats. Most of all a big thank you to Esther for mentioning Greta's weight which was 8.4 kilos and Candice for weight management advice, on the advice I was given and regular weight checks since September 2025 Greta's weight is now 6.4 kilos she is a completely different dog enjoying her walks and so full of energy before the weight loss she struggled to jump on the sofa and our bed not a problem now, she's so happy. The receptionists are lovely too, the best thing I have ever done for Greta is to change to Beehive Vets, you are all so caring.
From going to the reception to seeing the nurse service was excellent, always polite and very friendly.

I would like to express my sincere thanks to Luke, Candice, and the entire team at Beehive Vets for looking after my 13-year-old Poodle, Bat, during her recent ultrasound check ups and dental procedure.

As Bat is a senior dog with Stage 2 Chronic Kidney Disease and MMVD, I was naturally very anxious about her undergoing general anaesthesia for the dental surgery. However, the team was incredibly reassuring from the start. Candice provided excellent pre-op advice and thoroughly addressing my concerns.

During the procedure, Luke looked after Bat beautifully. Not only did he successfully address her dental issues in one go but he also performed a thorough ultrasound check-up for her heart/chest. Afterwards, he provided a very clear post-op breakdown and giving honest, practical advice regarding her newly discussed chronic cough.

Having recently moved to this lovely independent practice from a larger hospital, I can truly feel the difference. The communication here is thorough, transparent, and genuinely patient-focused. As a non-native English speaker, I am also deeply grateful for their patience in explaining everything so clearly to me.

Bat is now recovering comfortably at home. I am incredibly grateful to the team for their expertise and kindness, and I highly recommend Beehive Vets to any pet owner.
Always feel at ease seeing the vet and making sure buddy is ok very happy in what she said Thankyou
Friendly staff, appointment on time. Reasonably priced for a cat booster.

We joined the healthy hive club a couple of weeks ago and Bella came for her health check up and flea and worm treatment, everyone was so lovely , I also wanted information on spaying and our vet was so informative ,answered all my questions and more . Thank you I feel like I can make a good decision now
Again thank you for looking after my dog so well, I could'nt ask for any better service every time we visit.

Had to nip our dog Sandy in this morning for an emergency check over, possible concussion! Beehive vets (Rothwell) were great, got us in straight away and gave her a good check over (and a few treats!!). Staff are always really friendly and welcoming.
Sandy was all good in the end too.

I had our first visit to Beehive Vets for 2nd injections for our 12 week old Cairn Terrier, she had a lovely warm welcome and a lots of cuddles. She had a thorough check and I was given helpful advice and reassurance that she’s doing well. Very pleased with my decision to switch to this local practice.

Swapped my dogs to this vet in December. He had a host of problems that his previous vets had never got on top of. Within a few weeks they had set out a plan and given treatment which actually worked. He has been the best he’s been in years! They are all so lovely too!

I love beehive vets they are so kind and caring and take brilliant care of our dog always have time to chat and check the pets and make sure they are fit and well and are happy to remind you when vaccinations are due to prevent your dog becoming ill , brilliant vet 😀 really happy keep up the good work …
Lloyd was extremely professional and informative of our options. Kept Charlie calm when examining him and has provided an excellent service as well as offering aftercare and advice if needed.

First time at this practice brining our rescue cat for health check, microchip and vaccinations. What a really lovely surgery, the receptionists were friendly chatty, interested. The vet was also fabulous, answered all my questions and was very professional and interested in our cats history.  Would certainly recommend.
Friendly staff, very helpful.
Thanks Julie, it's very kind of you to leave a 5 star review for us!
Well organised vet practice. Welcoming staff and comfortably laid out building. My rabbits have good care. Staff are well informed, caring and friendly. Not cheap!
Happy with the treatment  today
Lovely friendly vets
Warm and welcoming for both pet and ower, they take time to build relationships and build confidence. great service from the moment you walk in to the moment you leave
A lovely practice with friendly, helpful staff.
Absolutely fantastic! Every member of staff is so caring, thorough and supportive. Switching to beehive is one of the best decisions we have made and we recommend to everyone
Very good very caring good Vets
Annual jab for Clyde, very quick and no trauma - for either of us!!
Thank you so much for the 5⭐ rating – we really appreciate your support!
Thanks Diane. It’s very kind of you to take the time to leave us a 5 star rating 🐝  …
Thank you Mark for the kind 5 star review, it means a lot to everyone here!
Thanks you Chloe, we really appreciate your 5 star review!
Thanks you Candice, for the kind 5 stars. It really helps a local business like Beehive!
Thank you Nic for the kind review, we all really appreciate you taking the time to give us positive feedback!

We randomly found this practice while looking for a second opinion for Mara — and it turned out to be incredibly lucky.

Our first vet only gave us two options: either very expensive treatment with no real guarantees, or to consider end-of-life (the Rainbow Bridge) — and this was without a proper examination. It was heartbreaking and left us feeling completely hopeless.

From the moment we arrived at this practice, everything felt different. We were welcomed with warmth, kindness, and genuine care. Esther was exceptional — professional, compassionate, and incredibly thorough. She took the time to properly assess Mara, explained everything clearly, and offered us four (!!!!) different options.

We were able to start a treatment plan straight away, and for the first time, I truly felt that Mara is in safe and capable hands. As pet parents, that level of care and professionalism means everything.

We called them in tears, feeling lost — and left with happy tears and real hope. That says it all.

Without any hesitation, I strongly recommend this practice.

Brian visited yesterday for his yearly check and booster. We were made very welcome even though Brian was his boisterous self and tried to wreck reception.
Lovely vets and great service
Thank you Phil, we really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a 5 star rating!
Thank you Grace, it's very kind of you to leave us 5 stars, it really does make a difference for a local, family-owned business like Beehive!
Thank you Emily for taking the time to leave us a 5 star rating! It makes a big difference to the whole team.

By far the best vet we’ve ever been to! I wouldn’t go anywhere else! We took our cat in for a second opinion after receiving a terrible diagnosis that would have resulted in an expensive and unnecessary operation. We came to Bee Hive, and Luke and Esther was fantastic! They are very knowledgeable, kind and at the top of their field. A year on, our cat has never been healthier, thanks to Luke and Esther.  Couldn’t recommend them more!
Took my dog and two cats to beehive today for a check up.... And all is well.. thank you beehive your amazing
Excellent Vets. Very helpful on dietary and general welfare issues , involving our Rescue Golden Retriever. Caring staff and excellent facilities and skills
Thank you Adele for your kind 5 star review! 🐝  …

What an absolute joke of a vets took my olive in as  she was not right in herself being very aggressive towards my other two dog was told she needs a good feed I was made to feel like I was neglecting my dog
Took her to another vets Who were amazing wasn’t flippant with the diagnosis and actually took time looking at her which they found she had major issues with her pelvis and back legs which were causing her pain that’s why she was aggressive not because she was hungry and recommended we put her to sleep for her own benefit what an absolute joke of a vets you are very lazy and unprofessional disgusting is probably the more appropriate word
Thank you Jan for the 5 stars, it means a lot to all the team 😊 🐝  …

I find Chloe a quiet and a calm vet which helps my dogs. Chloe quietly works away analysing  looking for the answers and will look for further information if required
She listens to my information and responds immediately. Very engaging with my dogs.

It's tough to write this. I think they are on the whole a good vet but if anything they have proven to me that you really cannot trust vets in this country full stop, regardless of what they appear to be.

I joined a monthly subscription that includes some services cheaper or free. We had some repeated treatments so this seemed like good value.

The treatment plan changed and this plan was no longer cost effective so I tried to cancel it only to be told that this was a credit agreement and to check my terms and conditions. I pointed out that nowhere on the posters, or in previous conversation was it explained that this was a credit agreement, and as far as I was aware I had not received any credit just have "terms and conditions" repeatedly barked at me.

The cost of it isn't massive so it's not the end of the world but i think the whole thing is disingenuous and massive breach of trust. I certainly won't trust them again in a hurry.

Love this family run vets banksy had a ear problem booked online got apt very quick all the employees are lovely the vet was lovely kind very professional made him feel at ease as he is nervous Thankyou
Thank you Rosina, we really appreciate the 5 stars. As a small, independent business it really helps us!

Staff were very welcoming and the practice itself is always clean and tidy. The vet himself was very knowledgable and gave me all the options available for the issue my cat was having. Have been using Beehive since they opened and have yet to have a negative experience.

Wonderful vets, so welcoming, friendly & don’t judge you because you own a flat faced breed ( brachycephalic) or recommend procedures that they don’t need, unlike the previous experiences we had before coming here 3 years ago. I would not let anyone else look after my 2 pugs & jug.
Always professional, informative and friendly, a very pet-centred practice. Happy to recommend them.

I started taking my two dogs to Beehive after a recommendation from a friend.  The vets I was with was just not offering what I needed for them.
I have no regrets at all!  All the staff here have been amazing from day one!  It’s so lovely to be part of a family run veterinary practice again.  To me they show so much more understanding of the needs of our lovely pets.
I would highly recommend this fabulous practice.
First visit to Beehive Vets. Very welcoming, very attentive, listened with patience, understood the problem, medication provided now waiting to see if Bertie feels better.🤞 …

Our first visit after someone recommended them to us. Lovely vet we saw, listened to our concerns not pushy or dismissive. Great first impression.
So much better than our previous vets.

Booked Holly in for a laparoscopic Spay as my own vets don’t offer this procedure. Due to the energy levels of Holly a young (Hungarian Vizsla)  I decided laparoscopic spay would be best.
From the initial consultation to the actual procedure and follow up I found all staff to be professional friendly and helpful.
If the clinic was closer to home I would have no hesitation in making them my chosen vets.

Never had a problem here , I changed vets when beehive opened , lost 3 sadly but looked after with care and compassion , now on next 3 ! , I certainly believe in communication and vet and owner relationship all important and I personally think I get this at beehive with all the staff x

We moved to Beehive after a bad experience at another vet and Beehive have been amazing - especially with our older dog who is suffering with heart problems.  They always take the time to explain different options to help us make informed decisions.  Highly recommend
A very friendly team and incredibly thorough. You can tell the staff love animals!

Hi Shaun. Thank you for your lovely review. We’re really pleased to hear you’ve found the team friendly and thorough, and it’s great to know our care for animals comes across so clearly—that really does mean a lot to us.

We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback.

Went to beehive vets with our cat Mylo for his annual booster and his eye checking. Mylo is very anxious but Olivia listened to what we do to help calm him whilst he’s there. Olivia was very gentle with him and he did really well. A great outcome for a anxious cat xx
Great vetinary surgery,  friendly polite staff and the vets are very knowledgeable.

The treatment we received for Walter was excellent. All the staff were very professional and caring.
Best wishes Alison and Colin

Excellent service and fantastic vetinary care! I've only been with Beehive Vets for a short period of time but I am very impressed with how caring, friendly, and thorough they are. In a climate where vet bills are going through the roof, I can honestly say that Beehive are extremely reasonable which is a breath of fresh air! Thank you to everyone at Beehive that has restored my faith in fair and honest vetinary care.

Scooby went for yearly health check and vaccinations. Excellent care received and the staff were very helpful and supportive. Best vets and staff are wonderful. Take time to listen. Relaxed atmosphere. Keep up the good work.
Absolutely amazing service from reception staff to the vet. Would definitely recommend this practice
Beehive are the best vets! They are caring , accommodating and they offer the best advice and care. The community are very lucky to have such an amazing vets on our doorstep

I can honestly say that this vet practice is the best that I’ve ever used. The care is amazing and they only do what’s necessary and don’t charge a fortune. Recently our bull terrier was anxious about having her nails clipped and the light sedation that we gave her didn’t work so we made an appointment for stronger sedation. When it actually came to it, she needed a scan of her heart to make sure she was ok to have it and when Luke rang to say she was ready for collection, he said that she was so relaxed during the scan that she let him clip her claws without sedation! 😃 that saved us a lot of money and I love that they didn’t do it anyway so to earn more money. I would recommend Beehive Vets to anyone and we’ll continue to use them.
Top services!
Fabulous vets, thank you so much for looking after Doris, highly recommended 🥰🥰 …
Excellent, very kind and friendly. Very quick with my cat's vaccination.

We have been bringing our German Shepherd to Beehive Vets since he was a puppy. They have been amazing with him especially during his recent operation. We want the best for Wallace and we get that with these vets. All the staff that have been in contact with our dog including reception staff have always been so patient and helpful. We are also very grateful to Candice and Steph who are very knowledgeable and always have answers to our questions. Thanks to everyone for also being so understanding when he is being very vocal in reception waiting for his appointments. It’s nice to know Wallace’s health and wellbeing is a genuine priority at this practice🙂

I have been bringing Rosie to Beehive vets for 5 years now. All staff are welcoming, friendly and professional and very good with Rosie too. She has seen several of the vets and nurses and they are very thorough and caring. Rosie has been seeing Chloe for a year now, with several problems, she has really looked after her so well. This last visit was for her boosters and kennel cough, Chloe checked her over thoroughly and asked about any concerns before proceeding with her boosters, which Rosie didn’t even flinch. As usual the receptionist was friendly and polite. Thank you all at Beehive Vets.
Excellent service my dog I very nervous and the staff where brilliant with him.

My dog Sam was attacked and had multiple cuts/tears to his ear. Beehive vets were fantastic  the reception staff were very kind and helpful as l was quite traumatised.Sam was well looked after by the lovely nurses and vet. Thankyou so much to all of you.Your all stars.
We’re so grateful for your 5⭐ review – thank you!
Great service as usual from all staff thank you

I cannot recommend the team at Beehive enough. We moved our 2 cats from a large franchise to Beehive after experiencing an impersonal and cold approach. Beehive feels like a family, they do not follow a corporate one size fits all approach and are so warm, attentive, friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. One of my cats is always getting into trouble and the feeling of having the same team answer the phone or see her every time makes things so much easier and calmer. Recently, she needed surgery and Beehive acted quickly but still made us feel a part of an informed decision. They kept us updated and even rang during recovery just to see how she was doing. Beehive don’t have an overnight facility or an out of hours emergency department which has made me nervous at times when moving from the larger franchise but when my cat went to their partners at Swift this last week it was also amazing, with clear communication all the way along and reassured me even more I had made the right decision. I cried a lot last week with the team at Beehive handing me tissues and I spent a lot of time in the waiting area chatting to the lovely ladies on reception who really took my mind off of things. They know that you don’t want to make decisions about your fur babies based on money but Beehive always take this into consideration when running through options with no feeling of pressure, they even complete all the Insurance forms for you. They always have time to fit us in and you never feel a burden. The whole team are pet owners & lovers and treat our animals how we would want them to be treated. It’s the little things like replacing a spoiled blanket with a clean towel of theirs in her carrier that go a long way. The Healthy Hive Club (Pet Plan) is exceptional value for money too. Please pass on mine & Smudge’s deepest thank yous to Larna, Chloe, Michael, Olivia, Luke & Esther in particular and to the whole team!
Always good service at this vets. I highly recommend using them if you want your animal(s) looked after . There is a pleasant atmosphere in the vets. Beehive vets cannot be recommended enough.
First class veterinary practice. The care all the staff take is brilliant.
Absolutely brilliant service vet was lovely

I have always found the service at Beehive to be excellent. Pricing regime is clear and explanations of issues are given with clarity. Very sympathetic and caring when l lost my cats. Would totally recommend.
We really appreciate your support and your 5⭐ rating – thank you from the whole team 🐝 …

All 5*.
Full fee given during consultation
operation done on same day
Aftercare included in price
Staff great
Clean
Great vets

Beehive vets have been amazing with my boy he’s recently had ivdd and the level of care to both him and myself as been above and beyond. My boy loves going to vets as they show him so much love from the receptionist to the vets he’s a French bulldog so full of energy but they totally understand that he’s not always going to sit still for them and show so much patience

Really pleased with the vets they are very helpful
And have helped my dog with his skin problem after years of trying other vets . Thank you beehive
Hi Fi! Many thanks for the kind review, it makes everyone's day to know you are happy with your experience here!

My favourite thing about Beehive is that they follow your lead when it comes to your pet. My dog is not the easiest one to handle, being too giddy and anxious, but they follow my advise to a T and our visits are quick and smooth. I appreciate that very much 🙏🏻 …
New vet not seen before. Gave Rosie a great check over and reassured us. Back for vaccinations soon. So will follow up then
Excellent vets, really care and treat both you and your pets with dignity and respect. From the receptionists to the vets they are top class. Would highly recommend them.
